evidence.quote: Therefore, we conclude that this gap is likely not physically real, but rather an effect caused by the projection of the disk

evidence.quote: We find that $^{12}$CO traces the upper disk atmosphere

claims.hypothesis: Is emission height related to disk mass and disk size?

referee_caveats_inferred: Per-disk visual masking and manual removal of diffuse points make surfaces hard to reproduce exactly
Sample is only 13 disks for surfaces and 6 for CS, so correlations (r about 0.2-0.7) have limited significance and no p-values are given

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 100-500 GB for 15 disks x 3 lines of imaged cubes (fiducial and high-sensitivity versions); VADP products are small
reproducibility.score_reason: Data and derived products are public and most fitting settings (emcee walkers, SNR clips, smoothing, peak-finding) are given with numeric results, but calibration/imaging, DISCMINER geometry, per-disk masks and some priors are deferred or unstated.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public exoALMA data and VADP, an explicit surface and temperature recipe, and numeric results (mean <z/r>, T_atm, T_mid, correlations) allow an approximate redo, though per-disk visual masking limits exactness.
